A vector in the plane of \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) is \(\vec{r} = x\vec{a} + y\vec{b} = (x+y)\hat{i} + (x-y)\hat{j} + (x+y)\hat{k}\).

text: The number of all values of \(\theta\) in the interval \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) satisfying the equation \((1-\tan\theta)(1+\tan\theta)\sec^{2}\theta+2\tan^{2}\theta=0\) is
solution:
Let \(t = \tan^2\theta \ge 0\). Then \((1 - \tan\theta)(1 + \tan\theta) = 1 - t\) and \(\sec^2\theta = 1 + t\), so the equation is \((1 - t)(1 + t) + 2t = 0\), that is \(t^2 - 2t - 1 = 0\).

So \(t = 1 + \sqrt{2}\) (the other root, \(1 - \sqrt{2}\), is negative).

\(\tan\theta = \pm\sqrt{1 + \sqrt{2}}\) gives one \(\theta\) each in \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\): 2 values.
